entry.title: MORI 0.3.1
entry.summary: First public release of MORI, a love letter to MEMENTO | Enjoy-Lab (own circuitry programmed by logic; not their code, not a clone, not a port). Tested on Akai Force. Five pages: PLAY, DELAY + REVERB, TEXTURE, FRAGMENT, ROUTING. DUB loop, tempo delay, multi-head and grain texture, reverb with shimmer, bipolar filter, master FX, 14-way routing matrix. Install: unzip and follow INSTALL.md, or run install.sh on the device (MPC OS 3.x, armv7 Force/MPC). User guide: docs/USER_GUIDE.md. PolyForm Nonco
